label: About
title: About Lavender Calibration Rupture
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 526 recent saved-signal files and 157 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @dadabots: 🥳 Announcing Stable Audio 3 🍕 🏆 fastest music models ever 💻 runs on MacBookPro... and @trq212: Lots of people asked how I used Fable to edit its own launch video so I made a video..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Lavender Calibration Rupture: Nocturnal lavender audio-observatory test plate, a diagrammatic fold seen as a side-lit object slab. A large pale circular aperture ruptures a black gridded field, cropped by tabs and bars; translucent lavender bands cross beneath it. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central torn pale circular aperture, broad translucent lavender diagonal launch strip, and left and right purple-lit rail slits.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
